name: tinhead-mcp

tools.name: explain_unavailable
tools.description:
The Tinhead door is not open, so no thoughts can be read or written yet.

Tell the person exactly this, including the command:

no connection is stored on this machine yet.
In Tinhead: Settings › Plugins › MCP gives you a setup code. Then run `tinhead-mcp login`
and paste it.

Retrying these tools will not help — this process holds no connection to
retry with. It opens again the next time the assistant is started.
